name: m1_bgm_xl
note: 用户 2026-10-01 试听第一轮样带后选定：芦湾水镇探索用 XL 种子 11（已是 XL，不重做）；普通战斗用 2B 种子 11、旧渡首领战改用普通战斗的 2B 种子 33。两首以选中的 2B 音频为底，用 XL 做 cover 重新渲染（跟随强度 1.0），保留结构与旋律、提高音质。

tracks.title: 普通战斗（XL 重新渲染）
tracks.caption: Instrumental Chinese martial arts (wuxia) battle music for a video game. Driving Chinese war drums with fast rhythmic patterns, energetic pipa tremolo and rapid strumming, erhu and dizi trading a bold heroic melody, a staccato string ostinato and short low brass accents. Tense yet heroic with constant forward momentum and steady energy throughout. No vocals, no electric guitar, no synthesizer.
tracks.structure:
[Intro - war drums and string ostinato]

[Theme A - erhu melody over pipa strumming]

[Theme B - dizi answers, drums intensify]

[Theme A - full ensemble]

[Break - drums and pipa tremolo]

[Theme B - erhu and dizi together]
